title: Food & cafés near Qawra
intro: A practical, source-linked shortlist for an AX ODYCY base in Qawra, with café and restaurant options nearby plus three useful Valletta food stops. Menu prices, hours and review counts are snapshots checked 9 October 2026; follow the linked business source for the latest details.
notes: Hotel stay is the traveller-provided base. Do not assume a hotel meal plan, buffet walk-in access or outside-visitor access; ask the venue if that affects your plan.
All numeric menu examples are in euros and are examples, not a per-person meal estimate. Where no current price was visible, it is marked as not published rather than estimated.
Tripadvisor and Google Maps ratings/counts are dated platform snapshots, not endorsements or permanent rankings. Individual review text is not used as a factual claim.

Platform access audit: Tripadvisor pages were directly accessible for selected listings; Google Maps was directly accessible for Cheeky Monkey, Venus and Is-Suq Tal-Belt. Yelp, Facebook, Instagram, TikTok and Reddit attempts returned HTTP 403; X search also returned HTTP 403. One previously accessible X post was unrelated to this shortlist. No content from blocked platforms is represented as observed; search snippets were used only to locate candidate sources.
Important hours conflicts are called out on the affected listings. Reconfirm directly before a specific dinner or event-day plan, especially for Sunday service and late returns.
Valletta listings are wider-island options for a day in the capital; this page does not estimate journey times. Check the Transport page / official planner for a date-specific route.

platform_audit.scope: Restaurant listing pages were directly opened for selected Qawra, Bugibba, St Paul's Bay and Valletta businesses. The guide records aggregate rating/count snapshots only and does not treat them as quality verification.

Direct listing pages were opened for Cheeky Monkey Gastropub, Venus and Is-Suq Tal-Belt. Peking's own website displays a Google aggregate, but its outbound g.page link returned HTTP 500; that aggregate is attributed to the business website rather than described as a direct Google-page check.
Direct review/search requests were blocked; no Yelp content is presented as observed.
Direct business-page requests were blocked; no Facebook posts or reviews are presented as observed.
Direct profile requests were blocked; no Instagram content is presented as observed.
A Qawra/Malta restaurant search and a venue-profile request were blocked; no TikTok content is presented as observed.
Direct requests were blocked; no Reddit content is presented as observed.
The search endpoint returned HTTP 403. A previously accessible public post was unrelated to Qawra dining; no X claim is used.

sections.title: At AX ODYCY and around Qawra
sections.lead: Useful on-site choices first, followed by nearby cafés and restaurants. The hotel’s published times do not establish that a meal is included in your booking.

items.name: Espresso Grab & Go
items.address: AX ODYCY Hotel, Level 0, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
items.hours: Daily, 24 hours (as published by AX Hotels).
items.price_range: An official food-and-beverage menu is linked; current item prices were not transcribed. Ask before budgeting.
items.description: Hotel coffee bar serving barista coffees, fresh juices and snacks. The hotel page describes it as open round the clock; the page does not state whether non-hotel visitors may enter.
items.notes: Convenient for an early start or late return if you are staying at AX ODYCY. Access is not independently confirmed for outside visitors.

supporting_sources.claim: AX Hotels links an Espresso food-and-beverage menu PDF from this page.

items.name: Deck & Keel
items.address: AX ODYCY Hotel, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta (Deck and Keel are separately located inside the hotel).
items.hours: Deck: breakfast 05:30–10:00; lunch 12:30–14:30; snacks 16:00–17:00 (Sunday 16:30–17:30); dinner 18:00–21:30. Keel: breakfast 08:00–11:00; lunch 12:30–14:30; dinner 18:30–21:30. Published hotel schedule; reconfirm for your stay.
items.price_range: Not published on the restaurant page. Ask whether walk-ins/non-residents are accepted and for the current buffet price.
items.description: Two on-site buffet restaurants with separate meal sittings. The published schedule is useful for planning around a hotel stay, but does not say that these meals are included in any particular room booking.
items.notes: Check the hotel's meal-plan terms separately; this listing does not establish what is included in the traveller's reservation. A walk-in tariff was not found.

items.name: Trattoria Riccardo
items.address: Level -1, AX ODYCY Hotel, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
items.hours: Monday–Sunday 12:00–22:30, according to the restaurant's current page.
items.price_range: Current official menu examples: pasta €9.75–€17.50; mains €15.50–€29.50. Check the linked menu PDF for the full, current list.
items.description: Hotel-based Italian restaurant with a current food-and-beverage menu and online table-booking link. A convenient full-meal option at the Qawra base.
items.notes: Tripadvisor snapshot: 4.8/5 from 2,651 reviews on 2026-10-09; this is a dated platform aggregate, not a ranking guarantee.

supporting_sources.claim: The official March 2026 menu PDF lists pasta and main-course examples, including tagliatelle al ragù €15.50 and tagliata di manzo €29.50.
Tripadvisor displayed 4.8/5 and 2,651 reviews for Trattoria Riccardo.

items.name: Minoa Mediterranean Fusion
items.address: AX ODYCY Hotel, Qawra Coast Road, Qawra SPB 1902, Malta
items.hours: Wednesday–Saturday 18:30–22:30, according to the restaurant's published information. Adults-only, 16+.
items.price_range: Official tasting menus: €70 per guest (vegetarian) and €80 per guest (standard). À la carte prices are shown on the linked live menu.
items.description: Hotel restaurant offering a Mediterranean-fusion menu and tasting-menu option. Reserve ahead and check the current menu; the tasting menu is a whole-table order by 20:30 according to the restaurant page.
items.notes: Tripadvisor snapshot: 5.0/5 from 764 reviews on 2026-10-09. The score/count are a dated platform aggregate, not a quality guarantee. Confirm the 16+ policy and availability when booking.

supporting_sources.claim: The official food menu lists vegetarian tasting at €70 and standard tasting at €80 per guest, ordered by the whole table by 20:30.
Tripadvisor displayed 5.0/5 and 764 reviews for Minoa.

items.name: Medusa Sky Bar
items.address: Level 10, AX ODYCY Hotel, Dawret il-Qawra, St Paul's Bay SPB 1902, Malta
items.hours: Monday–Sunday 20:30–01:30, according to the venue's contact page. Adults-only, 18+.
items.price_range: No current drink-menu price was verified; consult the venue before budgeting.
items.description: Hotel rooftop sky bar on level 10. Treat it as a drinks/night-out option, not a confirmed full-meal venue; check entry, booking and event arrangements with the hotel.
items.notes: The operator's page states the opening schedule and 18+ rule; it does not establish whether hotel guests need a reservation or whether an event changes access.

items.name: Cheeky Monkey Gastropub
items.address: Qawra Coast Road, Qawra, St Paul's Bay, Malta
items.hours: Sunday–Thursday 12:00–00:00; Friday–Saturday 12:00–01:00. Last food order 22:30. Happy hour 16:00–19:00, as published by the business.
items.price_range: Official menu examples span €8.25 for a snack to €26.50 for a main; these are item examples, not a meal budget.
items.description: Casual restaurant/bar with a broad menu of snacks, sandwiches, burgers and mains. The operator publishes a late-evening food cutoff, which is useful if you return after an event.
items.notes: Google Maps showed a 4.5/5 rating in the limited listing view on 2026-10-09. The extracted review count varied between page fragments and is deliberately omitted. Hours/menu may change; confirm happy-hour terms directly.

supporting_sources.claim: The official food-menu PDF lists snack and main-course examples and an allergen/cross-contact warning.
Google Maps listing displayed a 4.5/5 aggregate; review-count fragments were inconsistent, so no count is quoted.

items.name: Cheeky Monkey Crêperie
items.address: Dawret il-Qawra, St Paul's Bay, Malta
items.hours: Daily 08:00–23:00, as published by the business.
items.price_range: Official menu examples: build-your-own crêpes/waffles from €5.00; named crêpes €5.50–€7.75; tea €1.85 and coffee from €1.95. Menu says prices include VAT.
items.description: Breakfast-friendly café and dessert stop serving crêpes, waffles, ice cream, coffee and other drinks. An easy option when a full restaurant meal is not needed.
items.notes: Menu prices are taken from the directly accessible business PDF; ask staff about allergens because the menu warns that cross-contact cannot be ruled out.

supporting_sources.claim: The official crêperie menu PDF lists its crêpes, waffles, drinks and prices and states prices include VAT.

items.name: Lovage Bistro
items.address: Triq l-Imhar, Qawra, St Paul's Bay, Malta
items.hours: Official site: Tuesday–Saturday 18:30–22:00; closed Sunday and Monday. Tripadvisor lists Sunday service, so Sunday hours conflict; call or use the official booking page before planning a Sunday dinner.
items.price_range: Current official menu examples: starters €11–€14; mains €26–€30.
items.description: Evening bistro with an online menu and booking information. A higher-priced dinner option in Qawra; the official schedule is the safer source for planning.
items.notes: Phone +356 7959 4098. Tripadvisor snapshot: 4.7/5 from 576 reviews on 2026-10-09. The official website says Sunday closed while the Tripadvisor listing shows Sunday 19:00–22:30; do not assume Sunday service.

supporting_sources.claim: The official online menu lists current starter and main-course examples.
Tripadvisor displayed 4.7/5 from 576 reviews and a Sunday-hours listing that differs from the operator's site.

items.name: Venus Restaurant
items.address: Pioneer Road / Triq il-Gandoffli, Buġibba, St Paul's Bay, Malta
items.hours: Google Maps and Tripadvisor both list daily 18:00–22:30. The restaurant's own pages checked here do not publish hours; confirm directly if timing matters.
items.price_range: Official menu examples include chicken €23.50, rabbit €26.50 and beef Wellington €35; daily specials/fish may be priced differently.
items.description: Family-run Mediterranean restaurant with daily specials and seafood/meat dishes. The operator's menu and contact page are available online; reservation is advisable for dinner.
items.notes: Phone +356 9984 6767. Platform snapshots on 2026-10-09: Google Maps 4.9/5 (count fragments varied) and Tripadvisor 4.8/5 from 2,900 reviews. Scores differ by platform; neither is a guarantee of quality.

supporting_sources.claim: The official menu lists dish prices and identifies menu examples; some daily specials are separate.
Google Maps listing showed 4.9/5 and daily 18:00–22:30 hours in the captured view.
Tripadvisor displayed 4.8/5 from 2,900 reviews and daily 18:00–22:30 hours.

items.name: Ta' Pawla Restaurant
items.address: 320 Triq It-Turisti, St Paul's Bay, Malta
items.hours: Tripadvisor currently lists Monday–Saturday 18:00–23:00 and Sunday 12:00–16:00 plus 18:00–23:00. The business website checked here does not publish hours; call before relying on this schedule.
items.price_range: No current euro price list was verified in the accessible official menu text; ask for the current à-la-carte or set-menu prices.
items.description: Family-run restaurant describing its offer as traditional Maltese, Italian and Mediterranean food, including fish, meat, pasta, salads and pizza. The official menu page also mentions vegetarian and gluten-free options.
items.notes: Phone +356 9949 2049. Tripadvisor snapshot: 4.3/5 from 1,872 reviews on 2026-10-09. The schedule and address are review-platform listing data, not a confirmed operator timetable.

supporting_sources.claim: The official restaurant page describes its Maltese/Italian/Mediterranean offer and links to the menu.
Tripadvisor displayed the 4.3/5 aggregate, address and listed hours.
Booknbook's business profile lists the address and telephone number; no timetable was visible in the fetched page.

items.name: Made in Sud Pizzeria
items.address: Triq il-Patri Ġużepp Calleja, St Paul's Bay, Malta (use the map pin or phone for the exact entrance; postal codes vary among listings).
items.hours: Tripadvisor and Apple Maps both list Monday closed and evening service, but weekday start times differ by up to 30 minutes. Wolt lists delivery Tuesday–Sunday 18:00–23:30; this is a delivery window, not proof of dine-in hours. Call to confirm.
items.price_range: Tripadvisor shows its relative '$' band, not a euro quote. No current first-party dine-in menu price was verified; check the menu before budgeting.
items.description: Pizzeria specializing in Neapolitan pizza and Italian food. Tripadvisor and Apple Maps provide matching street/phone details; the linked business Facebook page was inaccessible in this audit.
items.notes: Phone +356 2702 0248. Tripadvisor snapshot: 4.7/5 from 1,121 reviews on 2026-10-09. A separate Tripadvisor record with a similar name also appeared; counts have not been combined. Apple Maps and Tripadvisor dine-in listings differ slightly on hours.

supporting_sources.claim: Apple Maps lists the pizzeria, phone, address and an evening schedule; its listed times differ slightly from Tripadvisor.
Wolt lists the venue's delivery schedule as Tuesday–Sunday 18:00–23:30 and Monday closed.

items.name: Peking To-Go & Peking Street Food
items.category: Chinese / Asian restaurant and street food
items.address: Triq it-Turisti, San Pawl il-Baħar, Malta (the postal code differs among listings).
items.hours: Peking To-Go: Monday–Sunday 12:00–22:30. Peking Street Food next door: Monday–Sunday 10:00–23:00, as displayed on the current official homepage. Tripadvisor's single listing says open until 23:00; use the operator's separate schedules for the two kitchens.
items.price_range: Official homepage sample dishes are €9.80–€13.50; examples only, not the full menu or a per-person estimate.
items.description: The current business website describes two neighbouring kitchens: a family Chinese restaurant/takeaway and a modern Asian street-food kitchen. It links to separate ordering/booking routes and shows the current address and service windows.
items.notes: Phone +356 2158 0696. Tripadvisor snapshot: 4.4/5 from 917 reviews. The business homepage embeds a Google 4.6/847 summary, but its outbound g.page link returned HTTP 500; that Google aggregate is attributed to the business homepage and was not directly rechecked on Google Maps.

supporting_sources.claim: Tripadvisor displayed 4.4/5 from 917 reviews and one Qawra listing with hours until 23:00.

items.name: Nine Lives
items.address: Perched Beach, St Paul's Bay, Malta
items.hours: Daily 09:00–23:00, according to the venue's current FAQ.
items.price_range: Official menu examples: starters €9.95–€16.50; mains €16.00–€34.50; sharing platters €37–€120. Check the linked menu for current items.
items.description: Seafront venue with breakfast, brunch, sushi, pizza, pasta, mains and cocktails. The official page says walk-ins are welcome, while recommending a booking for sunset tables and weekend evenings; beach-sunbed access is a separate reservation.
items.notes: Tripadvisor snapshot: 4.7/5 from 2,873 reviews on 2026-10-09. Rating/count are a platform snapshot, not an endorsement.

supporting_sources.claim: The official current menu lists food prices and describes the menu range.
Tripadvisor displayed 4.7/5 from 2,873 reviews for Nine Lives.

items.name: Café Maroc
items.address: db San Antonio Hotel & Spa, Tourist Street, Qawra, Malta
items.hours: The currently fetched official hotel page says Monday–Sunday 10:00–23:00. An earlier extracted version of the same first-party page showed 08:30–23:00; confirm with the hotel if an early opening matters.
items.price_range: No current item prices were visible on the official page; it links to the venue menu.
items.description: Coffee, hot and cold drinks, pastries, cakes and snacks inside db San Antonio. The hotel explicitly welcomes non-hotel guests; its current page says the outlet is card-only.
items.notes: Tripadvisor snapshot: 4.6/5 from 219 reviews on 2026-10-09; its listing also shows 10:00–23:00. Earlier official-page extraction differed on the morning opening time, so do not rely on 08:30 without reconfirming.

supporting_sources.claim: The official hotel page describes the café, gives its current hours and says non-hotel guests may visit; it also states card-only payment.
Tripadvisor displayed 4.6/5 from 219 reviews and hours 10:00–23:00.

items.name: Michele's Cafe
items.address: Tourist Street, St Paul's Bay 1672, Malta
items.hours: Tripadvisor listing: Sunday 06:00–22:00; Monday–Thursday 06:00–21:00; Friday–Saturday 06:00–22:00. No current first-party hours source was found; call before planning breakfast.
items.price_range: Not published in an accessible current first-party menu.
items.description: A café listed for breakfast and European-style food on Tourist Street. Use its current map/review listing for contact and directions; the accessible official social link was not available in this audit.
items.notes: Phone +356 2757 9505. Tripadvisor snapshot: 4.7/5 from 459 reviews on 2026-10-09. Opening times are a platform listing only and have not been confirmed by the operator.

sections.title: Valletta day-out food stops
sections.lead: These are useful wider-island options to pair with time in the capital. Their menus and schedules are separate from the Qawra-area shortlist; verify transport and same-day opening before setting the itinerary.

items.name: Caffe Cordina
items.hours: Official contact page: Monday–Saturday 07:30–21:00; Sunday 07:30–15:00. Tripadvisor lists different Sunday hours; prefer the operator's page and confirm on the day.
items.price_range: Official online shop examples: cannoli €4.35–€5.03. The linked dining-menu PDF is dated May 2024 and includes pastizzi at €1.50 and a full breakfast at €13.50; verify these older menu prices before budgeting.
items.description: Long-established Valletta café and patisserie serving coffee, sweets, breakfast and meals. The business dates its story to 1837 and publishes a current contact page and menu link.
items.notes: Tripadvisor snapshot: 3.9/5 from 4,733 reviews on 2026-10-09. The official schedule differs from the Tripadvisor listing, especially Sunday; use the official hours and recheck before travel.

supporting_sources.claim: The official linked dining menu contains breakfast and snack prices; the PDF is dated May 2024.
The official homepage displays current online-shop prices for two cannoli products.
Tripadvisor displayed 3.9/5 from 4,733 reviews and a Sunday schedule that differs from the official contact page.

items.name: Ta' Nenu
items.address: 143 St Dominic Street, Valletta VLT 1605, Malta
items.hours: Daily lunch 12:00–14:30 and dinner 17:30–22:00, according to the operator's current booking/contact information.
items.price_range: Official February 2026 menu examples: traditional ftajjar €13.50–€15.50; listed main courses €19.50–€24.50. See the current PDF for all menu items.
items.description: Traditional Maltese restaurant focused on ftira and local dishes, including rabbit and other Maltese specialties. The current website is branded Ta' Nenu (formerly Nenu The Artisan Baker) and offers a reservation request form.
items.notes: Phone +356 2258 1535. Tripadvisor snapshot: 4.5/5 from 1,858 reviews on 2026-10-09. The 2026 menu is first-party; menu prices and hours can still change.

supporting_sources.claim: The official February 2026 menu lists current ftajjar and main-course examples in euros.
The official booking/contact content lists the Valletta address, phone, daily meal periods and reservation request terms.
Tripadvisor displayed 4.5/5 from 1,858 reviews and the Valletta address.

items.name: Is-Suq Tal-Belt — Valletta Food Market
items.hours: Google Maps listing checked 2026-10-09: Monday–Wednesday 11:00–22:00, Thursday 11:00–20:00, Friday–Sunday 11:00–22:00. The retrieved official Food Court page did not expose a complete schedule; confirm same-day hours with the operator.
items.price_range: Varies by stall; there is no single food-court price list. Check the current stall menu linked from the operator's page.
items.description: Covered food court and market in Valletta with international and Maltese options, including the separately listed grocery market downstairs. The current food-court page lists 14 entries, one marked 'Coming Soon'; check which stalls are operating on the visit date.
items.notes: A useful group option when people want different cuisines, but individual vendors and opening times can vary. Google Maps snapshot: 4.3/5 from 8,582 reviews on 2026-10-09; its schedule is third-party listing data, so verify it with the operator before a late meal.

supporting_sources.claim: The operator's Food Court page describes its vendor mix and currently lists 14 entries, including one marked 'Coming Soon'.
The direct Google Maps listing displays the market name, Triq il-Merkanti address, hours and a 4.3/5 rating from 8,582 reviews.
The operator's Contact page describes Is-Suq Tal-Belt as being in central Valletta and gives public-transport and ferry access context.
